images.name: 01-dashboard
images.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity desktop web app UI prototype screenshot for ApplyFlow, job application and interview preparation. Landscape 1536x1024 composition. Straight-on pixel-clean screen filling canvas, no laptop mockup, no perspective, no outside decorative margin. Tasteful Apple-inspired productivity UI (not Apple branded). Almost monochrome white/light cool gray #f5f5f7 background, near-white content, delicate frosted translucent white left sidebar about 240px, very subtle neutral blurred gray background shapes visible only through sidebar, thin gray dividers, subtle edge highlights and small soft shadows. Absolutely no colorful blobs, no purple, no beige, no giant hero, no dramatic glass borders, no glass on all cards, no 3D. Deep charcoal text #1d1d1f with clear secondary gray, sparse blue #0066cc primary action and active navigation. System sans typography akin SF Pro/PingFang, restrained 30px heading, ample deliberate whitespace, readable realistic product density. 10px input/button radius, 18px large-panel radius. Thin line icons without colored icon boxes. Consistent left sidebar: ApplyFlow wordmark, navigation 工作台 / 职位申请 / 面试准备 / 个人资料 / AI 设置; user Alex Chen at bottom, a small 演示数据 label. Main toolbar lightweight translucent white. All headings and interface labels in accurately rendered simplified Chinese, company/technology names in English. Prioritize legible text. This is a visual design concept, no code. PAGE: 工作台 selected sidebar. Main header 工作台 and subtitle 每一次准备，都离下一步更近。 Blue top-right button 添加职位. One horizontal compact statistics strip, not 4 huge cards: 全部申请 24 / 已投递 12 / 面试中 5 / Offer 2. Below, spacious main white panel 最近申请 with understated search, tabs 全部 / 已投递 / 面试中. Well-aligned table columns 公司与岗位 / 地点 / 状态 / 更新时间. Five illustrative rows: Northstar — Backend Engineer — Sydney — 技术面试 — 今天; Fieldwork — Software Engineer — Melbourne — 已投递 — 昨天; Linear Labs — Graduate Developer — Remote — 已保存 — 2 天前; Orbit Studio — Full Stack Engineer — Sydney — HR 面试 — 3 天前; Clearpath — Backend Developer — Remote — Offer — 4 天前. Small low-saturation status badges with clear text. A narrower right column titled 准备重点 with three plain rows Go 并发 / SQL 索引 / Redis 缓存 and small progress labels 正在学习 / 可以解释 / 待复习, no percentages. Bottom of that column a modest 下一步 panel prompting 完善技能档案 with text link 查看个人资料. Clean carefully balanced geometry.
